hero.manifesto: No factory. No team. No millions in funding. Just you and your hands.
hero.description: Anyone with passion, dedication and skills can build real products from scratch.

meta.val: Companies that started small and built empires
Build real products from scratch and ship them

paragraphs: BYC — Build Your Creations — is a personal brand created by Yonathan in India in 2026. It was born from a simple idea: you dont need a factory, a big team or millions in funding to build something real.
You need motivation to keep going. Dedication to finish what you start. Passion for what youre building. And the skills to make it work. Thats BYC. Thats the whole philosophy.
Every product under the BYC brand is built from scratch — hardware, software, design, everything. One creator. Real products. Shipped to real people.

pillars.name: Motivation
pillars.desc: Never stop building. When something fails, rebuild it. When something breaks, fix it. The only way to fail is to stop.

pillars.name: Dedication
pillars.desc: Finish what you start. Ideas are cheap. A finished product on someones desk is worth everything. Ship it. Always.

pillars.name: Passion
pillars.desc: Love what you create. It shows in every line of code, every solder joint, every detail. Products built with love feel different.

pillars.name: Skills
pillars.desc: Engineer real solutions. Learn what you need, apply it immediately. Every problem is just a skill you havent learned yet.

vision.quote: Anyone can build real products from scratch — no excuses.
vision.body: BYC exists to prove that one person with the right mindset can build hardware products that people actually want to buy. Not prototypes. Not demos. Real products, shipped to real customers.

products.name: NavDevice
products.desc: A compact motorcycle navigation display. Real-time turn-by-turn directions on your handlebar. Voice guidance. Phone stays in your pocket.

products.name: SmartDash
products.desc: A full motorcycle smart dashboard. Speed, fuel level, engine temp and navigation all on one display. Built on ESP32.

contact.subtitle: Get in Touch
contact.title: Lets Build Something.
contact.body: Interested in a BYC product? Want to collaborate? Have an idea you want built? Reach out — Yonathan reads every message.
